description:
## Goal

A prompt-manager skill that guides agents through adding a widget to a scenario end-to-end: declaration in widgets.ts, data-attribute application, iframe-bridge verification, and auditor passing.

## Expected Work

- Write the skill under `scenarios/prompt-manager/store/skills/packs/core/widget-authoring/` with proper SKILL.md formatting.
- Include concrete examples of a settings-section widget and a CRUD-form widget.
- Cross-reference the widget-standard initiative.

## Acceptance

- An agent following the skill can add a working widget from scratch to an existing scenario UI.
name: widget-authoring-prompt-manager-skill
